notablePrerequisites: You control a number of creatures equal to or greater than 7 plus Leonardo's commander tax, if applicable.
description:
Cast Leonardo either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} due to its cost reduction.
When Leonardo enters, Angelic Sell-Sword and Genesis Chamber trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonardo, adding {W}.
Put Leonardo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.
